versions.changelog:
Initial release of alexa-cli skill.

- Control Amazon Alexa devices and smart home features via the `alexacli` CLI.
- Supports speaking/announcing on Echo devices, smart home device control (lights, thermostats, locks), sending voice commands, and querying Alexa.
- Includes text-to-speech, device management, audio playback, conversation history, and Alexa LLM (Alexa+) commands.
- Provides multiple installation options (Homebrew, Go) and optional environment-based authentication.
- Offers comprehensive command reference and usage instructions.
